entries.bodyEn: The most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character among them. And the best of you are those who are best to your women.
entries.bodyAr: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا وَخِيَارُكُمْ خِيَارُكُمْ لِنِسَائِهِمْ خُلُقًا

entries.bodyEn: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You while I know it, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.”
entries.bodyAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لا أَعْلَمُ
entries.tafsir: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to Abū Bakr after telling him that shirk moves among people more hiddenly than the creeping of ants — a daily refuge from its small, unnoticed forms.
